title: Gooey: A GPU-accelerated UI framework for Zig
summary: Gooey is a GPU-accelerated UI framework designed specifically for the Zig programming language, enabling developers to build high-performance graphical user interfaces by leveraging GPU rendering capabilities instead of traditional CPU-based UI rendering.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of modern, GPU-accelerated UI framework options available in the Zig ecosystem for building high-performance desktop applications.
why_valuable: It brings GPU-accelerated UI rendering to Zig, enabling significantly better performance for UI-intensive applications compared to traditional CPU-rendered frameworks.
